plan.title: Approval Control Plane — beginner-friendly human-in-the-loop
plan.goal: The human authorizes plain-language decisions with one tap; the system's automations do ALL the cryptography, invisibly. Replaces expert SOPS/age/Ed25519/offline-signing friction with a beginner-safe control surface.
success_criteria: A closed approval-request record whose plain-language layer can never leak crypto, bound by a canonical hash to the action that runs (WYSIWYS)
A WebAuthn-gated signer: the human taps a key, the system signs; an autonomous agent cannot forge authorization
A beginner surface (approve/deny in plain language) + a runbook engine that runs the whole multi-step activation the human never sees
Lost-key recovery + headless/rescue authorization with the same guarantees
UI/UX deployed and functioning (dev-mode); crypto hardening + owner enrollment locked down when the system matures

phases.goal: PRD + per-slice design packets, independently reviewed

items.name: Per-slice design packets P0-P4 (+P1b) + folded reviews
items.goal: each slice designed, independently reviewed (local + Antigravity), findings folded
items.validation_goal: Antigravity CRITICAL request_id-replay caught + fixed pre-build
items.editorial_note: review caught a real critical bug local+orchestrator missed

items.name: P0 — approval-request record + audited executor
items.goal: closed 3-layer record, canonical hash binds request_id, privacy boundary, bounded action, state machine

items.name: P1 — WebAuthn signing service core
items.goal: fetch-by-id + recompute (WYSIWYS), single-use + executed-id ledgers, verify_execution_authorization, no software-auth in prod
items.editorial_note: the crypto core; software authenticator test-only

items.name: P2 — approval surface (route + accessible view)
items.goal: Layer-1-only cards, approve->signer (no bytes/keys), CSP/kiosk, live-sync-disable, a11y

items.name: P3 — runbook automation engine
items.goal: idempotent/resumable audited executor, atom pre-check, scope-bound, authorized-once, no-shell, declarative coupling + 5 runbooks
items.editorial_note: runs the multi-step activation the human never sees

items.name: P1b — lost-authenticator recovery
items.goal: multi-authenticator allowlist (primary+backup), no-empty-allowlist, console-gated recovery, no stored secret
items.editorial_note: no single point of human-factor failure

items.name: P4 — headless/rescue aq-approve CLI
items.goal: FIDO2 hidraw CLI reusing the identical signer path, no passphrase/key-file downgrade, software-auth test-only
items.editorial_note: authorize a revoke from a rescue console

items.name: Deploy — wire the surface into the live dashboard (dev-mode)
items.goal: approvals router + /approve view registered in the dashboard app; fixture store/signer (crypto deferred); real effects stubbed
items.validation_goal: module imports; 3 fixtures render; dashboard restart makes /approve live
items.editorial_note: owner-directed 2026-08-17: deploy UI/UX functioning now, defer crypto

detection.blocker_note: needs a dashboard service restart to serve /approve live

items.name: Harden + activate — confined services, real WebAuthn/owner keys, real effects

items.validation_goal: full approve->sign->execute loop end-to-end, observable + intervenable (Activation Gate)
